{07 00 00}I don't know anything about
{ff 00 00 03}Flea Markets{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}

{07 1b 00}But leftovers always sound
good to me!

{07 00 00}So today's the day to get
rid of your old junk?
Eh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Well, I bet it would all look
great in your house, since
it's a big junk pile anyway!

{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! Listen, I know
you wanna run around and
see people's old junk.
But if you're not at home,
{07 0f 00}then I can't see YOUR
old junk.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}I know everybody calls the
{ff 00 00 03}Flea Market{ff 00 00 00} the
"Free Market"{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}
But you still have to pay
for stuff! {07 16 00}That makes
no sense!{01 00 00 14 00}
Let's call it the "Stupid
Pay Market" or something,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}I'm gonna shop for stuff at
your house next, so you'd
better clean that pigsty!
{07 15 00}I'm gonna be a guest in
your house, dadblastit!
{0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
